purpose: Maintainer-prepared route, capability, data-access, and regression-test navigation inventory for independent tenant/site-isolation review issue #14.
scopeNote: The catalog is a curated route-family inventory. Source anchors are checked against the current files and line numbers are generated. Route patterns, capability descriptions, data-access notes, and test limitations remain maintainer-authored metadata; they are not inferred proofs of runtime behavior.

commonControls.name: Authentication and developer-token boundary
commonControls.description: Session authentication is backed by the identity store. Browser-cookie writes require same-origin and CSRF validation. Development tokens are disabled in production.

commonControls.name: Site selector reconciliation
commonControls.description: siteIdFor compares route, x-virgoscorpio-hub-site-id, query, and body selectors; rejects duplicated/conflicting/malformed selectors; resolves an explicit or membership-derived site; and verifies membership before route-specific capability checks.

commonControls.name: Capability authorization
commonControls.description: requireCapability delegates non-developer authorization to identity.authorizeSite. Some route families use path site IDs directly with this guard rather than siteIdFor; the route catalog calls out those differences for assessor verification.

commonControls.name: Own-content and collaboration authorization
commonControls.description: Content read/edit scope and collaboration-document authorization include ownership, document type, site and active-session checks where applicable.

families.title: Health, readiness, metrics and static application surfaces
families.authentication: Mixed: health/readiness and selected static resources are public; metrics and admin surfaces have separate deployment/runtime controls.
families.siteContext: No ordinary tenant selector. These operational/static surfaces must not expose tenant records, secrets, or privileged diagnostics.
dataAccess: Process health and configured dependency state
sideEffects: Read-only responses; no tenant writes are expected.

coverage.limits: Health and readiness behavior has automated coverage; deployment-specific metrics/admin exposure and reverse-proxy policy require environment review.

families.title: Authentication, MFA, password recovery, federation and sessions
families.authentication: Public credential/callback flows plus authenticated session-management flows.
families.siteContext: Primarily account/session scoped. Invitation acceptance and identity-provider state must remain bound to the intended site/issuer and one-time state.
sideEffects: One-time invitation and federation state consumption

coverage.limits: Unit and HTTP tests cover important token/session controls. Exhaustive cross-site invitation, SAML/OIDC provider, recovery-token and stale-session adversarial review remains external.

families.title: Site discovery and site creation
families.authentication: Authenticated session; developer-preview behavior is separately constrained.
families.siteContext: Collection-level identity operation. Listing is actor-scoped; creation delegates ownership/bootstrap policy to the identity service.

coverage.limits: Identity unit and API coverage exists; owner handoff, concurrent ownership changes and creation abuse need independent assessment.

families.title: Site membership administration and invitations
families.siteContext: Each path site ID is reconciled through the shared siteIdFor helper against the x-virgoscorpio-hub-site-id header, siteId query values, and JSON body siteId on writes. Conflicting or duplicated selectors fail with a site-context 400 before capability authorization or identity-store operations. The resolved path site is then checked for site:manage.

coverage.limits: Unit tests assert resolver-before-capability ordering. The live A/B integration scenario rejects path/header, path/query and path/body conflicts for member listing, member creation and invitation creation, then compares membership, invitation, mail-outbox and audit snapshots for both sites. Foreign-user membership and invitation controls remain covered. Last-owner concurrency, broader role combinations and revocation of active streams remain independent-review work.

families.title: Design system, reusable components, templates, taxonomy, relationships, menus and AI policy
families.siteContext: Path-site route families; implementations use route/path site IDs and route-specific capability guards. Some handlers also reconcile other selectors through siteIdFor; verify each operation individually.

coverage.limits: The route capability suite checks deny-before-data-access for selected GET routes; it does not prove all operation methods, foreign object IDs, concurrency or outbox/graph effects for every family.

families.title: Custom content-type registry and records
families.siteContext: Site resolved by siteIdFor; shared content-read policy is supplied by the API composition layer. Record list/detail storage receives the selected site and actor ownership scope.

coverage.limits: Unit and composition tests exercise authorization ordering and own-only storage lookups. Two-site same-slug, foreign record IDs, search/count leakage and all mutation paths require reviewer expansion.

families.title: Pages, drafts, revisions, restore and editorial workflow
families.siteContext: Site selected through siteIdFor. Page/object reads and writes pass site plus content ID to the content store. Workflow operations use route-specific capabilities and own-content exceptions only where explicitly supported.

coverage.limits: The A/B suite reuses foreign page IDs against selected read/revision/collaboration/restore/publish paths and snapshots relevant state; all workflow actions, owner exceptions and concurrency still need independent coverage.

families.title: Durable collaboration operations and synchronization
families.siteContext: Site resolved at the API layer; document lookup binds site and content ID, then validates document type, edit capability and owner rules.

coverage.limits: Selected foreign document IDs and stale/invalid collaboration cases are covered; replay, reconnect, membership revocation during active collaboration and all cross-instance paths remain reviewer work.

families.title: AI generation, governance and task history
families.authentication: Authenticated session for generation/task history; task capabilities depend on configured stores and provider state.
families.siteContext: AI operations resolve optional/required site context through ensureSiteCapabilityForAI and apply the selected site's policy, quotas, classification and usage controls.
dataAccess: AI task metadata and encrypted payloads

coverage.limits: Tenant-bound task cursors, payload AAD, policy and provider guards have focused tests; every selected-page/context/provider path and concurrent quota isolation require broader review.

families.title: Authenticated media listing and upload
families.siteContext: Selected site passed through siteIdFor before media:manage checks and store access.
sideEffects: Object write followed by metadata write
Compensating object cleanup on metadata failure

coverage.limits: File signature and storage safety tests exist; remote provider IAM, object key collisions, deletion/reconciliation and media-specific two-site byte access require independent/provider testing.

families.title: Site-scoped library assets, versions, downloads and optimization
families.siteContext: Route site is supplied to siteIdFor and library:manage is required before store operations.

coverage.limits: A/B tests cover selected metadata/history/download/optimize/delete attempts and local bytes. Provider-specific storage, legacy assets, every variant type and live malware corpus remain open.

families.title: Public pages, search, product catalogs and membership-plan catalogs
families.siteContext: Site derived from a slug or explicit public site identifier. Published/active state and site predicates are the authorization boundary; anonymous does not mean cross-site.
sideEffects: Read-only responses; caches/public query paths must preserve site and visibility scope.

coverage.limits: Selected public catalog and publication behavior has tests. Slug collisions, cross-site query-loop joins, private/unpublished content, search counts and shared cache behavior require independent adversarial review.

families.title: Public media, library assets and public variants
families.siteContext: No caller-selected site. The asset ID resolves through store-level public/active/not-deleted predicates; bytes must match stored length/hash and media variants must match MIME signature and parent category.
capabilities: Public asset publication flag and active/quarantine state
sideEffects: Read-only byte delivery with public cache headers; cache lifetime and revocation behavior are security-relevant.

coverage.limits: Public/private and corrupted-variant checks exist. URL guessing, old caches after visibility change, object-provider policy and all media types require separate review.

families.title: Commerce products, orders, checkout, idempotency and refunds
families.authentication: Authenticated session; checkout additionally binds customer/order ownership and provider outcome.
families.siteContext: Site context is resolved for selected route operations; SQL and order/idempotency predicates must retain site, customer and object identity.

coverage.limits: A/B tests cover selected product/order access and idempotency-key reuse/foreign product IDs. Full concurrency, provider ambiguous outcomes, all refund transitions and live Stripe lifecycle are not certified.

families.title: Membership plans, subscription checkout and public plan access
families.authentication: Mixed: site plan administration/checkout requires authenticated actor; public plan catalog is anonymous.
families.siteContext: Plan operations use site-scoped predicates and memberships:manage. Provider subscription state must bind signed metadata to site, user and plan.

coverage.limits: Provider metadata binding and selected state reconciliation are tested with doubles. Live provider-generated events and two-site database behavior remain open.

families.title: Community profiles, groups, feed and friendships
families.siteContext: Route site passed to siteIdFor and member/policy checks; resource and recipient lookups should include site ID.

coverage.limits: A/B tests cover selected groups, joins, friendships and feed operations. Group-post/comment, profile privacy and all visibility combinations require reviewer expansion.

families.title: Community conversations, messages, blocks, reports, moderation and notifications
families.authentication: Authenticated site member; moderation actions require stronger capability.
families.siteContext: Workflow helper extracts path site, invokes siteIdFor and binds conversation, recipient, message and report lookup to the same site.

coverage.limits: A/B cases cover selected conversation/message/block/report/moderation/notification access and side effects. Complete workflow state transitions, group-private post visibility and event fan-out require further review.

families.title: Plugin registry, approvals, security review, activation and invocation
families.siteContext: Site resolved by siteIdFor; plugin lookup and all mutations bind both site ID and plugin ID.

coverage.limits: Manifest/signature/runner boundaries have unit coverage. Cross-site plugin ID, approval and invocation side-effect A/B tests and actual sandbox isolation remain open.

families.title: Site firewall rules and shared policy cache
families.siteContext: Path site is resolved through siteIdFor; site-specific rules are capability-guarded. GET deliberately includes global rules where site_id is NULL.

coverage.limits: Denied capability is tested before tenant data access. Global/site precedence, cross-site rule visibility and cache invalidation require reviewer verification.

families.title: Cloud connection configuration and provider probes
families.siteContext: Site selected by siteIdFor; connection reads, tests, updates and disable operations must bind site ID and connection ID.

coverage.limits: Unit tests constrain credentials and probes; site A/B connection IDOR, live least-privilege provider lifecycle and SSRF/egress controls remain open.

families.title: Mega-menu configuration
families.siteContext: Site passed through siteIdFor; GET checks content:read and writes check site:manage.

coverage.limits: A route-level denied-capability case exists; foreign slug/ID updates and deletion with before/after tenant state require A/B database tests.

families.title: Stripe billing webhook
families.siteContext: Tenant identity is bound through validated order/subscription metadata and database predicates, not a client-supplied site selector.

coverage.limits: Signed event and metadata-binding regressions use test doubles. Provider-generated payloads and two-site PostgreSQL callback execution remain external acceptance.

families.title: Presence HTTP, SSE, realtime events and WebSocket
families.authentication: Authenticated persistent session; WebSocket additionally enforces same-origin and reauthorizes commands.
families.siteContext: Path site plus realtime capability, active-session and per-command/document authorization. Redis topics and quota keys must retain site/principal/session dimensions.

coverage.limits: Selected two-site stream isolation, session invalidation, per-command reauthorization and Redis relay cases are covered. Forged cross-site payloads, every reconnect/replay path and production distributed quota behavior need independent review.

families.title: PostgreSQL outbox, delivery and worker execution
families.authentication: System worker; not an end-user HTTP route.
families.siteContext: Canonical event envelope carries schema version, site scope/classification, actor/resource identity and correlation; consumers validate subscription/scope before delivery.
capabilities: Worker identity and registered consumer subscription

coverage.limits: Envelope validation and retry/replay behavior have tests; hostile event injection, tenant teardown, all consumers and replay against a live multi-site dataset need independent review.

families.title: Memgraph projection and graph rebuild
families.siteContext: Projected graph nodes and relationships must carry site identity; query and rebuild paths must bind tenant plus aggregate/resource IDs and preserve version/tombstone ordering.

coverage.limits: Selected cross-site lookup and replay/rebuild behavior are tested. Forged envelopes, partition collisions, stale projection versions and site deletion cleanup require assessor review.

families.title: Redis presence and cross-instance realtime relay
families.authentication: Service-to-service adapter used by authenticated API streams.
families.siteContext: Channel/key naming and payload validation carry site scope; no user-provided raw channel or record data should be trusted.
capabilities: Redis service credentials and adapter configuration

coverage.limits: Unit and integration tests cover selected site-scoped channels and invalidation. Production Redis ACL, failover and hostile service payload review remain open.

families.title: Local library object reconciliation and storage adapters
families.authentication: Local operator/maintenance process; not a public HTTP route.
families.siteContext: Database references include local library assets, historical versions and media variants. The reconciler defaults to dry-run, rejects traversal and never follows symlinks.
capabilities: Local filesystem and PostgreSQL operator permissions
dataAccess: local filesystem or configured object-storage adapter
sideEffects: Dry-run reports orphan candidates; --apply deletes only eligible unreferenced local files.

coverage.limits: Local dry-run/traversal behavior is tested. Remote object storage, provider-side orphans, retention, concurrent reference creation and restore lifecycle are not covered by this reconciler test.
